import re, glob, collections
files = sorted(glob.glob('/app/logs/*'))
pat = re.compile(r'^(?P<date>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\s+(?P<time>\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})\s+\[(?P<sev>[^]]+)\]\s*(?P<msg>.*)$')
all_sevs = collections.Counter()
dates = set()
bad = []
for f in files:
    with open(f, errors='replace') as fh:
        for n, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
            m = pat.match(line.rstrip('\n'))
            if not m:
                bad.append((f, n, line.rstrip('\n')))
                continue
            dates.add(m.group('date'))
            all_sevs[m.group('sev')] += 1
print('files:', len(files))
print('dates:', min(dates), 'through', max(dates))
print('severity counts:', dict(all_sevs))
print('unparsed lines:', len(bad))
for x in bad[:20]: print(x)
